title.zh: 将巴拉望省普林塞萨港市巴拉望医院的病床容量从一百（100）张增至四百（400）张，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Ospital Ng Palawan in the City of Puerto Princesa, Province of Palawan, From One Hundred (100) to Four Hundred (400) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Ospital Ng Palawan in the City of Puerto Princesa, Province of Palawan, From One Hundred (100) to Four Hundred (400) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng công suất giường bệnh của Ospital Ng Palawan tại Thành phố Puerto Princesa, tỉnh Palawan từ một trăm (100) giường lên bốn trăm (400) giường và cấp kinh phí cho việc này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มความจุเตียงของออสปิตัลเอ็นก์พาลาวันในนครปวยร์โตปรินเซซา จังหวัดพาลาวัน จากหนึ่งร้อย (100) เตียง เป็นสี่ร้อย (400) เตียง และจัดสรรงบประมาณเพื่อการนั้น
title.id: Undang-Undang Meningkatkan Kapasitas Tempat Tidur Ospital Ng Palawan di Kota Puerto Princesa, Provinsi Palawan dari seratus (100) tempat tidur menjadi empat ratus (400) tempat tidur serta Mengalokasikan Dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta Meningkatkan Kapasiti Katil Ospital Ng Palawan di Bandar Puerto Princesa, Wilayah Palawan daripada seratus (100) katil kepada empat ratus (400) katil dan Mengeluarkan Peruntukan Wang untuk Tujuan itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 8 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2022/ra_11887_2022.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The authorized bed capacity of the Ospital ng Palawan, shall be increased from one hundred (100) to four hundred (400) beds. Any future increase in bed capacity shall be consistent with the hospital development plan which shall be prepared by the Department of Health (DOH).

The existing professional health care services and facilities of the Ospital ng Palawan shall also be upgraded to conform with and be commensurate to the increase in bed capacity as provided for in Section 1 hereof.
The existing workforce of the Ospital ng Palawan, which includes doctors, nurses, and support personnel, shall be increased correspondingly.

The DOH shall determine the staffing pattern of the Ospital ng Palawan subject to the evaluation and approval of the Department of Budget and Management, and appoint the officials and employees of the Ospital ng Palawan in accordance with existing civil service laws, rules and regulations.
The Secretary of the DOH shall immediately include in the Department’s program the implementation of this Act, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
If any provision or part of this Act is declared unconstitutional, the remaining parts or provisions not affected shall remain in full force and effect.
All laws, executive orders, issuances, rules and regulations inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
